# Game Idea: Asteroid Evader

- **Genre:** Simple arcade dodging game (HTML canvas)
- **Controls:** Arrow keys or mouse to rotate ship and thrust forward
- **Gameplay:** Asteroids spawn at random positions on the canvas edges and travel in straight lines across the screen. The player must maneuver the ship to avoid collisions while the ship drifts due to inertia.
- **Scoring:** Points accumulate over time survived, optionally increasing speed of asteroid spawn.
- **Lose Condition:** The game ends instantly when the ship collides with any asteroid.
- **Visuals:** Minimalist vector graphics; ship as a triangular shape, asteroids as circles or polygons.

This concept can be implemented with plain JavaScript and the HTML `<canvas>` element, requiring only basic physics and collision detection.

1: // Simple Asteroid Evader game
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
10:   // Background gradient for space
11:   const backgroundGrad = (() => {
12:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, width, height);
13:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#000020');
14:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000040');
15:     return grad;
16:   })();
17: 
18:   // Simple sound utilities using Web Audio API
19:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
20:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
21:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
22:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
23:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
24:     osc.type = 'sine';
25:     osc.connect(gain);
26:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
27:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
28:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
29:     osc.start();
30:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
31:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
32:   }
33:   function playThrust() { playTone(400, 0.08); }
34:   function playExplosion() { playTone(100, 0.4); }
35: 
36:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
37: 
38:   // Ship definition with gradient and thrust flame
39:     const ship = {
40:     isThrusting: false,
41:     isThrusting: false,
42:     x: width / 2,
43:     y: height / 2,
44:     vx: 0,
45:     vy: 0,
46:     angle: 0, // radians
47:     radius: 12,
48:     thrust: 0.1,
49:     rotateSpeed: 0.07,
50:     draw() {
51:       ctx.save();
52:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
53:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
54:       // Ship body gradient
55:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, this.radius * 0.2, 0, 0, this.radius);
56:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#6f6');
57:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#0a0');
58:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
59:       ctx.beginPath();
60:       ctx.moveTo(0, -this.radius);
61:       ctx.lineTo(this.radius, this.radius);
62:       ctx.lineTo(-this.radius, this.radius);
63:       ctx.closePath();
64:       ctx.fill();
65:       // Thrust flame when accelerating
66:       if (this.isThrusting) {
67:         ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
68:         ctx.beginPath();
69:         ctx.moveTo(0, this.radius);
70:         ctx.lineTo(this.radius * 0.5, this.radius + 10);
71:         ctx.lineTo(-this.radius * 0.5, this.radius + 10);
72:         ctx.closePath();
73:         ctx.fill();
74:       }
75:       ctx.restore();
76:     },
77:     update() {
78:       this.x += this.vx;
79:       this.y += this.vy;
80:       // screen wrap
81:       if (this.x < 0) this.x += width;
82:       if (this.x > width) this.x -= width;
83:       if (this.y < 0) this.y += height;
84:       if (this.y > height) this.y -= height;
85:     }
86:   };
87: 
88:   // Input handling
89:   const keys = {};
90:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; });
91:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
92: 
93:   // Asteroid definition
94:   const asteroids = [];
95:   const asteroidConfig = {
96:     minRadius: 15,
97:     maxRadius: 30,
98:     minSpeed: 0.5,
99:     maxSpeed: 2.0,
100:     spawnInterval: 2000 // ms
101:   };
102: 
103:   function randomBetween(min, max) {
104:     return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
105:   }
106: 
107:   function spawnAsteroid() {
108:     const radius = randomBetween(asteroidConfig.minRadius, asteroidConfig.maxRadius);
109:     // Choose a random edge
110:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
111:     let x, y, vx, vy;
112:     switch (edge) {
113:       case 0: // top
114:         x = randomBetween(0, width);
115:         y = -radius;
116:         break;
117:       case 1: // right
118:         x = width + radius;
119:         y = randomBetween(0, height);
120:         break;
121:       case 2: // bottom
122:         x = randomBetween(0, width);
123:         y = height + radius;
124:         break;
125:       case 3: // left
126:         x = -radius;
127:         y = randomBetween(0, height);
128:         break;
129:     }
130:     const angle = Math.atan2(height / 2 - y, width / 2 - x);
131:     const speed = randomBetween(asteroidConfig.minSpeed, asteroidConfig.maxSpeed);
132:     vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
133:     vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
134:     // generate irregular polygon vertices
135:     const points = [];
136:     const sides = Math.floor(randomBetween(6, 10));
137:     for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
138:       const theta = (i / sides) * Math.PI * 2;
139:       const offset = randomBetween(0.7, 1.3);
140:       points.push({ x: Math.cos(theta) * radius * offset, y: Math.sin(theta) * radius * offset });
141:     }
142:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius, angle: 0, points });
143:   }
144: 
145:   // Game state
146:   let lastTime = performance.now();
147:   let accumulator = 0;
148:   let gameOver = false;
149:   let score = 0;
150: 
151:   function update(dt) {
152:     if (gameOver) return;
153:     // Input
154:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.rotateSpeed;
155:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.rotateSpeed;
156:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['Space']) {
157:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
158:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
159:       ship.isThrusting = true;
160:       playThrust();
161:     } else {
162:       ship.isThrusting = false;
163:     }
164:     // Apply friction
165:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
166:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
167: 
168:     ship.update();
169: 
170:     // Update asteroids
171:     for (const a of asteroids) {
172:       a.x += a.vx;
173:       a.y += a.vy;
174:       // wrap
175:       if (a.x < -a.radius) a.x += width + a.radius * 2;
176:       if (a.x > width + a.radius) a.x -= width + a.radius * 2;
177:       if (a.y < -a.radius) a.y += height + a.radius * 2;
178:       if (a.y > height + a.radius) a.y -= height + a.radius * 2;
179:     }
180: 
181:     // Collision detection (circle vs ship point)
182:     for (const a of asteroids) {
183:       const dx = ship.x - a.x;
184:       const dy = ship.y - a.y;
185:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
186:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
187:         gameOver = true;
188:         break;
189:       }
190:     }
191: 
192:     // Score based on survival time
193:     score += dt / 1000;
194:   }
195: 
196:   // Pre-generate stars for background
197: const starCount = 100;
198: const stars = [];
199: for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
200:   stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
201: }
202: 
203: function draw() {
204:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
205:     ctx.fillStyle = backgroundGrad;
206:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
207:     // Background stars
208:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
209:     for (const s of stars) {
210:       ctx.beginPath();
211:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
212:       ctx.fill();
213:     }
214:     // Draw ship
215:     ship.draw();
216:     // Draw asteroids as irregular polygons
217:     for (const a of asteroids) {
218:       ctx.save();
219:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
220:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
221:       // Asteroid gradient fill
222:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.radius * 0.2, 0, 0, a.radius);
223:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
224:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
225:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
226:       ctx.beginPath();
227:       const pts = a.points;
228:       if (pts && pts.length > 0) {
229:         ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
230:         for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
231:           ctx.lineTo(pts[i].x, pts[i].y);
232:         }
233:         ctx.closePath();
234:         ctx.fill();
235:       } else {
236:         ctx.arc(0, 0, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
237:         ctx.fill();
238:       }
239:       ctx.restore();
240:     }
241:     // Draw score
242:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
243:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
244:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score), 10, 20);
245:     if (gameOver) {
246:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
247:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
248:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
249:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
250:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
251:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
252:     }
253:   }
254: 
255:   function loop(timestamp) {
256:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
257:     lastTime = timestamp;
258:     accumulator += dt;
259:     while (accumulator >= 16) { // ~60fps fixed step
260:       update(16);
261:       accumulator -= 16;
262:     }
263:     draw();
264:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
265:   }
266: 
267:   // Start spawning asteroids
268:   spawnAsteroid();
269:   setInterval(spawnAsteroid, asteroidConfig.spawnInterval);
270: 
271:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
272: })();

(End of file - total 272 lines)
</content>
